manager.label: Fixture variant (derived, not a simulator run)

layout.name: Fixture Hospital (hand-built, not a real plan)
layout.disclaimer: Fixture layout for development. Not a real hospital. All flows simulated.

action_spec.name: priority_rule
action_spec.desc: Who is taken next from the waiting queue into a bay / by a provider

action_spec.name: overflow_bays
action_spec.desc: Open hallway/overflow treatment spaces (needs nurses; lower quality, extra fixed cost)

action_spec.name: divert
action_spec.desc: Ambulance diversion: ambulance arrivals below ESI 2 severity are turned away

action_spec.name: call_in
action_spec.desc: Call in extra staff at overtime rate; arrive after a delay, stay to end of shift

action_spec.name: fast_track
action_spec.desc: Run the fast-track stream for ESI 4-5 (uses an APP and a nurse)

action_spec.name: provider_split
action_spec.desc: How providers divide time between new patients and re-evaluations/dispositions

action_spec.name: md_day
action_spec.desc: Providers on the day shift (07-15)

action_spec.name: md_evening
action_spec.desc: Providers on the evening shift (15-23)

action_spec.name: md_night
action_spec.desc: Providers on the night shift (23-07)

action_spec.name: rn_day
action_spec.desc: Nurses on the day shift

action_spec.name: rn_evening
action_spec.desc: Nurses on the evening shift

action_spec.name: rn_night
action_spec.desc: Nurses on the night shift

action_spec.name: triage_nurses
action_spec.desc: Triage stations staffed

action_spec.name: admission_cap
action_spec.desc: Cap on ED admissions per day once the ward is nearly full (transfers out instead)

action_spec.name: discharge_push
action_spec.desc: Early ward discharge rounds: frees beds sooner, costs staff time

action_spec.name: agency_contract
action_spec.desc: Agency nurses for the week at a premium rate (adds to every shift)

action_spec.name: imaging_hours
action_spec.desc: Hours the second CT and MRI are staffed

action_spec.name: bays_delta
action_spec.desc: Close or build treatment bays (physical capacity)

action_spec.name: ward_beds_delta
action_spec.desc: Close or open inpatient beds available to the ED

action_spec.name: equipment_buy
action_spec.desc: Buy and install a scanner

action_spec.name: relocate
action_spec.desc: Move a zone (changes walking times; zone closed during the move)

action_spec.name: headcount
action_spec.desc: Hire or reduce permanent staff (shifts the level->people mapping; hiring delay)
